VAG diagnostic protocols by era

Volkswagen Group vehicles moved through four main CAN diagnostic eras. Knowing your car’s era tells you immediately what VAG Scope can read and write.

EraProtocolExample platformsWhat VAG Scope supports
Before 2004K-Line (KWP1281 / KWP2000)Golf 4 (1J), A3 8L, A4 B5/B6Not supported on CAN-only ELM327 paths.
2004-2010CAN TP 2.0PQ35 (Golf 5, A3 8P), C6 (4F)Full offline scan, measuring blocks, coding, adaptations, mileage/VIN checks and Performance Hub.
2009-2014Mixed TP 2.0 + 11-bit UDSGolf 6, Passat B7, A1 8X, Octavia 2 FLAutomatic unit-by-unit protocol switching across both old and new modules.
2012-202011-bit CAN UDSMQB (Golf 7, A3 8V, Leon 5F), MLB / B9Full offline scan, rich multi-unit mileage/VIN checks, live data, coding and Performance Hub with no SFD lock.
2020+11-bit & 29-bit CAN UDS (4-hex)MQB-evo (Golf 8, Leon KL), MEB (ID.3, ID.4)Offline scan, 29-bit EV/hybrid modules, live data, health/mileage/VIN checks and Performance Hub. Online SFD write unlock is not supported.

Common compatibility questions

My exact VW, Audi, Seat or Škoda model is not in the table. Will it still work?

Yes, if it uses CAN TP 2.0 (roughly 2004-2010) or UDS on 11-bit or 29-bit CAN ids (roughly 2012 onwards). You can also preview the four built-in demo cars (Audi RS6 C6, Audi S3 8V, Audi A1 8X, VW ID.4 GTX) straight from the home screen before buying an adapter.

Does VAG Scope work on pre-2004 K-line cars like a Golf 4 or Audi A4 B6?

No. VAG Scope targets CAN TP 2.0 (2004+) and UDS (2012+) vehicles. Pre-2004 K-line-only cars (and some K-line-only comfort modules on early A4 B7s) are not supported over CAN-only ELM327 paths.

What does SFD protection change on 2020+ MQB-evo and MEB cars?

SFD/SFD2 requires an online server-signed token to unlock protected write commands. Because VAG Scope has zero network permission by design, it works 100% offline for scanning, fault codes, live data, mileage/VIN checks and Performance Hub, and deliberately does not perform online SFD unlocks.

Which adapter works on Android vs iPhone?

On Android, both Classic Bluetooth (SPP) and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) ELM327 adapters work; VAG Scope is built and tested with the vLinker MC+ and vGate iCar Pro 2S. The upcoming iPhone version requires a BLE adapter (both recommended models include BLE).

How can I help verify a model on a real car?

Use the Contact form at the bottom of the site or share an exported protocol log from your car so we can confirm exact control-unit coverage and add your chassis to the verified list.

Run the check on your own car

VAG Scope does it from your phone and a Bluetooth ELM327 adapter: no account, no network, and every result shows its evidence.
